subject.title: fix(edit): show candidate lines with similarity scores on oldText match failure

question: Which edit oldText mismatch diagnostic output should become the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97032, and should this concise branch be accepted after visible live proof and exact-head gates?
rationale: Multiple viable PRs implement the same user-facing diagnostic with different output contracts; tests can check bounds and behavior but cannot decide which presentation should ship.

options.title: Use This Concise Implementation
options.body: Land this mergeable PR after visible live proof and exact-head gates are acceptable, then close or rebase the overlapping candidate PRs.

options.title: Choose A Richer Candidate
options.body: If maintainers want more explicit escaped diff and indentation presentation now, pause this PR and choose a richer sibling such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97269.

options.title: Consolidate Before Merge
options.body: Port the preferred wording, bounds, and tests into one branch so only one edit mismatch diagnostic contract ships.

recommendation.title: Use This Concise Implementation
recommendation.body: Land this mergeable PR after visible live proof and exact-head gates are acceptable, then close or rebase the overlapping candidate PRs.
